dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Continuous, symmetrical narrowing from the mid-dorsal region toward the posterior peduncle, resulting in a tapered geometric profile.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Localized indentation on the left lateral margin approximately mid-body; right margin exhibits a relatively smooth, convex curvature.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Medium-to-dark slate grey across the entire dorsal surface, indicating a pre-mature textural phase.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Subtle, low-frequency mottling with slightly darker grey patches visible across the dorsal mid-section.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient boundaries between varying shades of grey pigmentation.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Four parallel, longitudinal linear marks (rake marks) located on the posterior dorsal plane; a single high-contrast white circular mark on the mid-left dorsal region.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: A visible longitudinal dorsal ridge along the central axis with a slight topological depression in the area of the posterior rake marks.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Distinct longitudinal rake marks on the posterior dorsal surface; multiple small, high-contrast white epidermal spots distributed across the mid-body.
other_distinctive_markers: Clearly defined blowhole aperture at the anterior end, appearing as a dark, recessed crescent-shaped feature.
